projects.name: Fixium Ecosystem
projects.description: Comprehensive platform for iOS repair shops, optimizing operations and security through a multi-tenant backend in Java Spring Boot, a cross-platform frontend in SvelteKit + Electron, and a local FastAPI service for diagnostics. Incorporates facial verification with AWS Rekognition, AI-powered technical tools, and image storage in Cloudinary.
highlights: Complete management of users, workshops, clients, devices, tickets and repairs
AI-powered technical tools (technical assistant and panic log analysis)
iOS device diagnosis and restoration with local FastAPI service

projects.name: Order Management Microservices
projects.description: Backend microservices system for managing products, orders and payments in a scalable and secure way. Uses Spring Cloud for centralized configuration, service discovery and a JWT-protected API Gateway, integrating efficient communication between microservices with OpenFeign.
highlights: Complete microservices architecture with Spring Cloud
Centralized Config Server and Eureka Discovery
Secure API Gateway with JWT and role control

projects.name: Inventory REST API
projects.description: Modular RESTful API for inventory, product and supplier management, with stock control, PDF report generation and image storage in Cloudinary. Developed with Spring Boot and JWT-based security.
highlights: Complete CRUD with validations and filters
